title: The Halfway House orchestra and Merritt Brunies
summary: He was too young and lived too far uptown to go to the Halfway House or the Bourbon Street dives.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: What about the Halfway House orchestra?

Merritt Brunies, I don't know. I'll tell you the truth, I was too young. I was too young to go out there. I don't know why, but I mean, I never got around to, I never got around to the, to the the whorehouses and the, and Bourbon Street as it was.
